# Orbit audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/orbit-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set orbit` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `iss_lab.mp3` is cut from "US Lab background.mp3" by ColChrisHadfield (Chris Hadfield), released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/ColChrisHadfield/sounds/172547/.
